settings_add.calendar_ics: # optional: private .ics URL or path (Google/Apple Calendar) merged by atlas.py calendar

tags_add: Calendar timeline, events, blocked dates, workouts, goals and to-dos
notes: Run `python -I <ROOT>/brain/_atlas/tools/atlas.py calendar --init --execute` (or `python3`) to harvest existing birthdays, dates and open to-dos from the brain into `brain/calendar/README.md` and link `calendar/README.md` in `brain/INDEX.md`, then tell the user what was imported.
